links.outcome: Word-level PII redaction precision and recall of de-identification tools versus dual clinician annotation
links.effect: Best tool Azure had F1 0.933, precision 0.916, recall 0.950. Fine-tuned AnonCAT recall was 0.787 and GPT-4 ten-shot recall was 0.874, so some PII was missed. Names and dates were consistently redacted.
links.quote: The best performing redaction tool was the Microsoft Azure de-identification service: F1 0.933 (0.928-0.938), precision 0.916 (0.930-0.922), recall 0.950 (0.942-0.957).

unlisted_practices: Comparing LLMs with few-shot prompting and purpose-built software for automated EHR de-identification
Fine-tuning a de-identification model on local records

screen.reason: The study empirically compares multiple LLMs and purpose-built NLP software on a retrospective clinical record de-identification benchmark dataset without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
